svg.title: Skill 10 - Reflog: your safety net
svg.desc: Animation: git reset --hard HEAD~2 makes commits C and D disappear from the branch; git reflog lists every position of HEAD; git reset --hard HEAD@{1} restores them.

g.text: HEAD is now at b2c3d4e B
b2c3d4e HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to HEAD~2
HEAD is now at d4e5f6a D
A branch with commits A–D. Time to do something scary…
git reset --hard HEAD~2 : C and D vanish from the branch. Panic?
git reflog lists every place HEAD has been — including D.
Point back to it with reset --hard HEAD@{1} — everything is restored.
The reflog is local and its entries expire (30–90 days by default). Commit early!
